newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine to spend $48 mn on aluminium plant upgrade.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine to spend $48 mn on aluminium plant upgrade.

text.p: Ukraine will spend 90 million hryvnia ($48 million) during the next three years to modernise an aluminium foil manufacturing plant at the Zaporizhya alumina smelter, government spokesman Anatoly Romanenko said on Monday.

The government has ordered various ministries to come up with money to fund the project and to service a 1993 credit line from Italy, given to Ukraine to construct modern facilities to produce 25,000 tonnes of foil yearly with the Italian firm Fata.
Romanenko told Reuters that modernisation of the plant at AT Zaporizhsky Aluminiyovy Zavod (ZAZ), in the eastern city of Zaporizhya, is scheduled for completion by the end of 1999.
Reconstruction began in 1993 but has been held up by a lack of money.
Ukraine has forecast aluminium output at 90,000 tonnes next year. It produced 80,900 tonnes between January and November, down seven percent from the same period last year.

It plans to phase out alumina production at the energy-inefficient Zaporizhya smelter and will bring around 200,000 tonnes of alumina annually from the Mykolayiv smelter -- Europe's largest -- to produce the foil.

The number of shares for sale in Ukraine's sole aluminium plant are still under discussion, but a company executive said previously that no less than 26 percent of shares would be offered to an investor. --Yuri Kulikov, Kiev Newsroom +380 44 229 2264
